tiny_fixture.description: Synthetic deterministic HRM; not a Mimir quality benchmark

real_model.weight_storage: FP32, same values as BF16 checkpoint

limitations: Library-level prototype; server lifecycle integration is not implemented or tested.
Three real prompts and four forced answer tokens per prompt; not a language-quality evaluation.
Diagnostic timings include startup/graph costs and are too short for stable throughput estimates.
Peak RSS is not total Metal memory.
Metal fused tests use F16 KV; unfused tests use F32 KV.
